notes: This focused portable trace covers only standard HLAreportException delivery and its Exception Reporting switch gate. It does not claim complete service-exception reporting, error-text normalization across RTIs, or overall MOM conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction permits a joined federate to send individual declared parameters; HLAexceptionReporting controls whether service-invocation exceptions are reported and defaults to HLAfalse.

When Exception Reporting is enabled, the RTI sends the standard HLAreportException interaction when a service invocation at the indicated joined federate raises an exception; the interaction supplies service and exception text and the reported federate identity.
